content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

The infrastructure we're discussing is not a workaround, but a base-layer solution that empowers digital creators to build, deploy, and scale their own sovereign digital commerce stacks. This means owning the entire infrastructure, including payment processing, ebook delivery, and order storage, without relying on third-party platforms that charge exorbitant fees. For instance, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference retains $921, a significant sum that can make a substantial impact on a creator's bottom line.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of five key components: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component works in tandem to ensure seamless payment processing, ebook delivery, and order storage. For example, when a customer makes a payment, NOWPayments triggers an automatic webhook that fires the moment payment confirms on-chain, prompting Cloudflare Workers to deliver the ebook instantly.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure solution is built for digital creators who want to sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and other digital products without relying on Stripe or PayPal. It's ideal for creators who value infrastructure sovereignty, scalability, and cost-effectiveness. The Components That Make It Work Together

The components of this infrastructure solution are carefully chosen to ensure seamless integration and scalability. For instance, Cloudflare Workers and Google Apps Script provide a robust backend logic that can handle high traffic and large volumes of data. Supabase and Google Sheets ensure secure and reliable order storage, while Google Drive and Cloudflare R2 provide fast and efficient file delivery. NOWPayments, with its 300+ cryptocurrencies and 0.5% fee, provides a seamless payment processing experience.
